orgs.name: Everest Pipkin
orgs.description: American artist and game developer whose Lacework slowly reanimates every video in the MIT Moments in Time dataset, and whose essay on it documents the violence hidden in training data.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家与游戏开发者，Lacework 把 MIT Moments in Time 数据集的每段视频缓慢重构，其配套文章记录了训练数据中隐藏的暴力。

orgs.name: Addie Wagenknecht
orgs.description: American artist whose Optimization of Parenthood uses a robot arm that rocks her baby's cradle when it cries, questioning what care becomes when it is automated.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，Optimization of Parenthood 中婴儿一哭，机械臂就会摇动摇篮，追问照护被自动化后会变成什么。

orgs.name: Nouf Aljowaysir
orgs.description: Saudi-born artist whose Salaf asks an AI to reconstruct her ancestors from colonial photographs of Arabia; the models erase and mislabel them, revealing a Western gaze in the data.
orgs.description_zh: 沙特出生的艺术家，Salaf 请 AI 从殖民时期的阿拉伯照片中重建她的祖先，模型却抹去并误标了他们，暴露出数据中的西方凝视。
known_for: Ana Min Wein (Where Am I From?) (2021)

orgs.name: Tom White
orgs.description: New Zealand artist whose Perception Engines are abstract prints that neural networks confidently classify as electric fans, hammerhead sharks or measuring cups, art made for machine eyes.
orgs.description_zh: 新西兰艺术家，Perception Engines 是一系列抽象版画，神经网络却能笃定地把它们识别成风扇或鲨鱼等物体，是为机器之眼而做的艺术。

orgs.name: Eva & Franco Mattes
orgs.description: Italian artist duo whose Dark Content gives anonymised voices to the content moderators who filter violent and obscene images for platforms, the human layer behind 'automatic' moderation.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利艺术家二人组，Dark Content 让为平台过滤暴力与淫秽图片的内容审核员以匿名身份发声，揭示“自动”审核背后的人类层。

orgs.name: Paolo Cirio
orgs.description: Italian artist whose Capture posted face-recognised images of 4,000 French police officers in the street, turning surveillance tools on the police; the work was censored.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利艺术家，Capture 把经人脸识别处理的 4000 名法国警察照片贴在街头，将监控工具转向警察，作品遭到审查。
known_for: Face to Facebook (2011, with Alessandro Ludovico)

orgs.name: Sofian Audry
orgs.description: Canadian artist and scholar of machine learning as an artistic medium, with robots that learn in front of the public; author of Art in the Age of Machine Learning (MIT Press).
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大艺术家与学者，研究作为艺术媒介的机器学习，其机器人在观众面前学习；著有 Art in the Age of Machine Learning（MIT 出版社）。
known_for: Art in the Age of Machine Learning (2021)

orgs.name: Nicolas Gourault
orgs.description: French filmmaker whose VO reconstructs the 2018 Uber self-driving crash through test drivers' accounts, and whose Unknown Label follows data labellers training autonomous cars.
orgs.description_zh: 法国电影人，VO 通过测试司机的讲述重构 2018 年 Uber 自动驾驶致死事故，Unknown Label 追踪为自动驾驶汽车标注数据的工人。

orgs.name: Kyriaki Goni
orgs.description: Greek artist whose Data Garden imagines data stored in plant DNA, and whose Not Allowed For Algorithmic Audiences explores the smart speakers listening in on our homes.
orgs.description_zh: 希腊艺术家，Data Garden 想象把数据储存在植物 DNA 中，Not Allowed For Algorithmic Audiences 探讨在家中“偷听”的智能音箱。

orgs.name: Auger & Loizeau (James Auger & Jimmy Loizeau)
orgs.description: British speculative designers whose Carnivorous Domestic Entertainment Robots feed on flies and mice to power themselves, re-imagining domestic robots as living things.
orgs.description_zh: 英国思辨设计师，Carnivorous Domestic Entertainment Robots 靠捕食苍蝇与老鼠供能，把家用机器人重新想象成有生命的东西。

orgs.name: Revital Cohen & Tuur Van Balen
orgs.description: Artist duo whose The Immortal connects life-support machines to each other in a closed loop that circulates fluids and air without a human body, a machine that only keeps itself alive.
orgs.description_zh: 艺术家二人组，The Immortal 把多台生命支持机器首尾相连，在没有人体的情况下循环液体与空气，成为只为维持自身而运转的机器。

orgs.name: Timo Arnall
orgs.description: British-Norwegian designer and filmmaker whose Robot Readable World compiles footage of computer vision at work, and whose Internet Machine films the physical data centres behind the cloud.
orgs.description_zh: 英国–挪威设计师与电影人，Robot Readable World 汇集计算机视觉工作时的画面，Internet Machine 拍摄“云”背后的实体数据中心。

orgs.name: Dan Chen
orgs.description: Designer whose RISD-era robotic intimacy series built machines that caress and comfort people; his Last Moment Robot strokes a dying patient's arm and speaks words of comfort, questioning machine care at the end of life.
orgs.description_zh: 设计师，他在罗德岛设计学院期间创作的“机器亲密”系列让机器抚摸、安慰人；其中 Last Moment Robot 在临终病人身边抚摸其手臂并说出安慰的话语，追问生命尽头的机器照护。

orgs.name: Keiichi Matsuda
orgs.description: British-Japanese designer whose film Hyper-Reality shows a Medellín bus ride in a city saturated by augmented-reality ads, gamification and assistant agents.
orgs.description_zh: 英日混血设计师，短片 Hyper-Reality 呈现麦德林的一段公交旅程，城市被增强现实广告、游戏化与助手智能体全面淹没。

orgs.name: Alexandra Daisy Ginsberg
orgs.description: British artist whose The Substitute brings back the last male northern white rhino as an AI-driven digital animal, asking why we prefer artificial life to the life we let die.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，The Substitute 以 AI 驱动的数字动物“复活”最后一头雄性北方白犀牛，追问为什么我们宁愿要人工生命，也任由真实的生命消亡。

orgs.name: Rashaad Newsome
orgs.description: American artist whose AI 'Being', a vogue-dancing, bell hooks-reading avatar, leads workshops and performances as a decolonial, queer machine persona.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，他的 AI“Being”是一个会跳 voguing、阅读贝尔·胡克斯的化身，以去殖民的酷儿机器人格主持工作坊与表演。

orgs.name: American Artist
orgs.description: American artist whose My Blue Window renders the city through a predictive-policing dashboard, confronting the racial logic of computational risk.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，My Blue Window 通过预测警务的仪表盘呈现城市，直面计算风险评估中的种族逻辑。

orgs.name: Tabita Rezaire
orgs.description: French-Guianese artist whose Deep Down Tidal follows undersea internet cables along the routes of colonial trade, framing digital networks as a continuation of empire.
orgs.description_zh: 法属圭亚那艺术家，Deep Down Tidal 沿殖民贸易航线追踪海底互联网光缆，把数字网络视为帝国的延续。

orgs.name: Minne Atairu
orgs.description: Nigerian-American artist who uses generative models to imagine the Benin bronzes that were never made after the 1897 British raid, confronting the gaps in the data of looted histories.
orgs.description_zh: 尼日利亚裔美国艺术家，用生成模型想象 1897 年英军洗劫之后未能诞生的贝宁青铜器，直面被掠夺历史在数据中的空白。

orgs.name: Mahwish Chishty
orgs.description: Pakistani-American artist who paints US military drones in the ornate style of Pakistani truck art, confronting the machine gaze over the Afghanistan–Pakistan border.
orgs.description_zh: 巴基斯坦裔美国艺术家，用巴基斯坦卡车装饰艺术的华丽风格描绘美军无人机，直面阿富汗—巴基斯坦边境上空的机器凝视。

orgs.name: Paola Torres Núñez del Prado
orgs.description: Peruvian-Swedish artist who weaves textiles and sound with AI, showing how machine vision misreads Andean and Amazonian visual cultures.
orgs.description_zh: 秘鲁裔瑞典艺术家，用纺织、声音与 AI 创作，展示机器视觉如何误读安第斯与亚马孙地区的视觉文化。

orgs.name: Karen Palmer
orgs.description: British 'storyteller from the future' whose interactive films read the viewer's facial emotions to steer the plot, so a police encounter plays out differently depending on how calm you look.
orgs.description_zh: 英国“来自未来的叙事者”，她的互动电影通过读取观众表情来推动剧情：与警察的对峙会根据你看起来是否冷静而走向不同结局。

orgs.name: Tomo Kihara
orgs.description: Japanese designer based in Amsterdam whose street game challenges players to reach a camera without being detected as a pedestrian, testing the failures of self-driving vision.
orgs.description_zh: 常驻阿姆斯特丹的日本设计师，他的街头游戏要求玩家走到摄像头前而不被识别为行人，检验自动驾驶视觉的失效。
known_for: How (not) to get hit by a self-driving car (2022)

orgs.name: Sun Yuan & Peng Yu
orgs.description: Beijing artist duo whose Can't Help Myself, an industrial robot endlessly sweeping a leaking red fluid back into place, became an emblem of machine labour, futility and exhaustion.
orgs.description_zh: 北京艺术家二人组，其《我无能为力》中工业机器人不停把渗出的红色液体扫回原处，成为机器劳动、徒劳与疲惫的象征。

orgs.name: Xu Bing
orgs.description: Chinese artist whose feature film Dragonfly Eyes is assembled entirely from public surveillance and livestream footage, telling a love story through the eyes of China's cameras.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，长片《蜻蜓之眼》完全由公共监控与网络直播画面剪辑而成，借中国摄像头的“眼睛”讲述一个爱情故事。
orgs.based_zh: 北京，中国 / 纽约，美国

orgs.name: Cao Fei
orgs.description: Chinese artist of labour, virtual worlds and automation; Asia One follows the only two workers in a fully automated logistics warehouse, falling in love among sorting robots.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，关注劳动、虚拟世界与自动化；《亚洲一号》讲述全自动物流仓库中仅有的两名工人在分拣机器人之间相恋。

orgs.name: Lu Yang
orgs.description: Chinese artist whose genderless digital avatar DOKU, motion-captured from the artist, is reincarnated across six realms, blending neuroscience, Buddhism and game engines.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，以自身动作捕捉生成的无性别数字化身 DOKU 在六道中轮回，融合神经科学、佛学与游戏引擎。

orgs.name: aaajiao (Xu Wenkai)
orgs.description: Chinese artist who works with the internet, bots and data as the material of everyday life under networked control; his avatar aaajiao reflects on identity inside platforms.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，以互联网、机器人程序与数据为材料，描绘网络控制下的日常；他的化身 aaajiao 反思平台之中的身份。
orgs.based_zh: 柏林，德国 / 上海，中国

orgs.name: Huang Yi
orgs.description: Taiwanese choreographer who programs an industrial KUKA arm as his duet partner; Huang Yi & KUKA opened Ars Electronica 2013, toured widely and made a factory robot move with tenderness.
orgs.description_zh: 台湾编舞家，亲自为 KUKA 工业机械臂编程并与之共舞；《黄翊与库卡》曾为 2013 年林茨电子艺术节开幕并在各地巡演，让工厂机器人动得温柔。

orgs.name: Lawrence Lek
orgs.description: Malaysian-Chinese British artist of 'Sinofuturism' whose films and games follow AI characters: a satellite that wants to be an artist, a self-driving car in therapy, a retired care robot.
orgs.description_zh: 马来西亚华裔英国艺术家，提出“中华未来主义”；他的影片与游戏讲述 AI 角色：想成为艺术家的卫星、接受心理治疗的自动驾驶汽车、退役的照护机器人。
known_for: Guanyin: Confessions of a Former Care Robot (2024)

orgs.name: Ho Tzu Nyen
orgs.description: Singaporean artist whose CDOSEA is an algorithmically edited, infinitely recombining 'dictionary' of Southeast Asia, handing the ordering of history to a machine.
orgs.description_zh: 新加坡艺术家，《东南亚批判辞典》由算法无限重组剪辑，把历史的编排交给机器。
known_for: The Critical Dictionary of Southeast Asia (CDOSEA) (2017–)

orgs.name: Sougwen Chung
orgs.description: Hong Kong-born Canadian artist who draws live with robotic collaborators (the D.O.U.G. series) trained on her own gestures, exploring authorship shared between human and machine.
orgs.description_zh: 香港出生的加拿大艺术家，与以她自身笔触训练的机器人（D.O.U.G. 系列）现场共同作画，探索人与机器共享的作者身份。

orgs.name: Jiabao Li
orgs.description: Chinese artist-designer and founder of Reality Design Lab (UT Austin) whose works on AI, care and more-than-human perception include AI Mom, a machine that performs motherhood.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家与设计师，Reality Design Lab（德州大学奥斯汀分校）创始人，其作品探讨 AI、照护与超越人类的感知，包括扮演母亲角色的机器 AI Mom。

orgs.name: Shu Lea Cheang
orgs.description: Taiwanese artist and net-art pioneer whose 3x3x6 at the Venice Biennale turned the surveillance of a panoptic prison onto visitors, through the stories of queer and gender-nonconforming prisoners.
orgs.description_zh: 台湾艺术家、网络艺术先驱，威尼斯双年展作品《3x3x6》借酷儿与性别不从者囚犯的故事，把全景监狱的监控转向观众。

orgs.name: Hsin-Chien Huang
orgs.description: Taiwanese new-media artist whose VR work The Eye and I, made with Jean-Michel Jarre, immerses viewers in a world of surveillance and watching machines.
orgs.description_zh: 台湾新媒体艺术家，与 Jean-Michel Jarre 合作的 VR 作品 The Eye and I 让观众沉浸于充满监控与“观看机器”的世界。
known_for: The Eye and I (2019, with Jean-Michel Jarre)
To the Moon (2018, with Laurie Anderson)

orgs.name: Wang Yuyang
orgs.description: Chinese artist whose Breathe series makes silicone replicas of everyday machines, from an ATM to a washing machine, slowly inhale and exhale, turning appliances into living bodies.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，《呼吸》系列让 ATM、洗衣机等日常机器的硅胶复制品缓慢地一呼一吸，把电器变成有生命的身体。

orgs.name: Liu Chuang
orgs.description: Chinese artist whose films trace the material and human underside of digital economies, from bitcoin mines in Inner Mongolia to lithium lakes and the linguistic data of minority voices.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，他的影片追踪数字经济物质与人的另一面：从内蒙古的比特币矿场到锂湖，再到少数民族声音被采集成语言数据。
known_for: Bitcoin Mining and Field Recordings of Ethnic Minorities (2018)

orgs.name: Li Liao
orgs.description: Chinese performance artist who worked 45 days on a Foxconn assembly line to earn the iPad Mini he then exhibited, embodying the human labour inside consumer machines.
orgs.description_zh: 中国行为艺术家，在富士康流水线工作 45 天，用工资买下自己组装的 iPad Mini 并展出，亲身体现消费电子机器中的人类劳动。

orgs.name: Guo Cheng
orgs.description: Chinese artist of science-fictional machines; his gif tutorial shows how to twist your face to escape detection, and The Net Wanderer tours the physical handshakes of the Chinese internet.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，创作科幻气质的机器装置；他以动图教程示范如何扭曲面部躲避人脸识别，《网络漫游者》则探访中国互联网物理层面的“握手”。
known_for: A Technique of Evading Face Detection (2020)
The Net Wanderer – A Tour of Suspended Handshakes (2020)

orgs.name: Hu Jieming
orgs.description: Shanghai pioneer of Chinese media art whose installations such as 100 Years in 1 Minute, a matrix of 1,440 boxes, compress history into machine-scaled time.
orgs.description_zh: 上海中国新媒体艺术先驱，其装置如由 1440 个盒子组成的《一分钟一百年》，把历史压缩进机器尺度的时间。

orgs.name: Miao Ying
orgs.description: Chinese artist of the 'Chinternet' whose works on censorship, filtered search results and platform culture show how machines shape what can be seen online in China.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，以“中国互联网”为题，关注审查、被过滤的搜索结果与平台文化，展示机器如何塑造网上可见之物。
orgs.based_zh: 上海，中国 / 纽约，美国

orgs.name: Lee Bul
orgs.description: South Korean artist whose headless, limbless Cyborg sculptures fuse the idealised female body with machine armour, questioning technology's fantasies of perfection.
orgs.description_zh: 韩国艺术家，她的无头断肢“赛博格”雕塑把理想化的女性身体与机械盔甲融为一体，质疑技术对完美的幻想。

orgs.name: Choe U-Ram
orgs.description: South Korean sculptor of 'anima-machines', delicate mechanical creatures with invented scientific names and life cycles; Little Ark is a ship of oars that rise and fall like breathing.
orgs.description_zh: 韩国雕塑家，创作“机械生命体”：拥有虚构学名与生命周期的精致机械生物；《小方舟》是一艘船桨如呼吸般起伏的船。

orgs.name: Ayoung Kim
orgs.description: South Korean artist whose Delivery Dancer's Sphere follows a female delivery rider in a Seoul run by an algorithmic platform that bends time and space.
orgs.description_zh: 韩国艺术家，《送货舞者之球》讲述一位女性外卖骑手在被算法平台支配、时空扭曲的首尔中穿行。

orgs.name: Shinseungback Kimyonghun
orgs.description: Seoul duo (Shin Seung Back and Kim Yong Hun) whose Cloud Face collects clouds that face detection mistakes for faces, making machine pareidolia visible.
orgs.description_zh: 首尔二人组（申承伯与金容勋），Cloud Face 收集被人脸检测误认成人脸的云，让机器的“空想性错视”显形。

orgs.name: Yunchul Kim
orgs.description: South Korean artist whose kinetic 'material machines' sense cosmic rays and fluid dynamics; he represented Korea at the 2022 Venice Biennale with Gyre.
orgs.description_zh: 韩国艺术家，他的动态“物质机器”感应宇宙射线与流体运动；2022 年以《Gyre》代表韩国参加威尼斯双年展。

orgs.name: Takayuki Todo
orgs.description: Japanese artist-engineer whose SEER is a small humanoid head that meets your gaze and mirrors your expression with delicate eyebrows, probing the threshold of machine empathy.
orgs.description_zh: 日本艺术家与工程师，SEER 是一颗会与你对视、用细腻眉毛模仿你表情的小型人形头部，探索机器共情的阈值。

orgs.name: So Kanno
orgs.description: Japanese artist whose Senseless Drawing Bot, made with yang02, is a wobbling robot that sprays graffiti with a pendulum, turning mechanical instability into gesture.
orgs.description_zh: 日本艺术家，与 yang02 合作的 Senseless Drawing Bot 是一台摇晃的机器人，靠钟摆喷出涂鸦，把机械的不稳定变成笔触。

orgs.name: Daito Manabe
orgs.description: Japanese artist and Rhizomatiks co-founder whose Electric Stimulus to Face let a computer drive his facial muscles, later extending to drones, dancers and brain-decoding works.
orgs.description_zh: 日本艺术家、Rhizomatiks 联合创始人，Electric Stimulus to Face 让电脑以电流驱动他的面部肌肉，之后延伸到无人机、舞者与脑解码作品。

orgs.name: Oriza Hirata
orgs.description: Japanese playwright who co-created android and robot theatre with Hiroshi Ishiguro; in Sayonara an android recites poetry to a dying young woman.
orgs.description_zh: 日本剧作家，与石黑浩共同开创仿人机器人与机器人戏剧；《再见》中仿人机器人为一位垂死的年轻女子朗诵诗歌。

orgs.name: Keiichiro Shibuya
orgs.description: Japanese composer whose android opera Scary Beauty has the android Alter 3 conduct an orchestra and sing, with tempo it decides itself.
orgs.description_zh: 日本作曲家，其仿人机器人歌剧《Scary Beauty》由 Alter 3 自行决定速度来指挥乐团并演唱。

orgs.name: Seiko Mikami
orgs.description: Japanese media-art pioneer (1961–2015) whose Desire of Codes (YCAM) fills a wall with insect-like camera arms that track visitors, making the audience's bodies the material of surveillance.
orgs.description_zh: 日本媒体艺术先驱（1961–2015），在 YCAM 发表的《Desire of Codes》中，墙上如昆虫般的摄像机臂追踪观众，使观众身体成为监控的材料。
known_for: World, Membrane and the Dismembered Body (1997)

orgs.name: Maywa Denki
orgs.description: Japanese art unit led by Nobumichi Tosa that presents absurd 'nonsense machines' and instruments as company products, performed by staff in blue work uniforms.
orgs.description_zh: 由土佐信道领导的日本艺术组合，以“公司产品”形式发布荒诞的“无用机器”和乐器，并由身穿蓝色工作服的“员工”表演。

orgs.name: Ei Wada
orgs.description: Japanese artist who turns obsolete appliances, such as CRT televisions and electric fans, into musical instruments, giving discarded machines a second life as a community orchestra.
orgs.description_zh: 日本艺术家，把显像管电视、电风扇等淘汰电器改造成乐器，让被遗弃的机器以社区乐团的形式获得第二次生命。

orgs.name: Kenji Yanobe
orgs.description: Japanese artist of survival machines and giant robots, from radiation suits after Chernobyl to post-Fukushima figures of hope.
orgs.description_zh: 日本艺术家，创作生存机器与巨型机器人，从切尔诺贝利之后的防辐射服到福岛核事故之后象征希望的形象。

orgs.name: Sputniko! (Hiromi Ozaki)
orgs.description: Japanese-British artist whose Menstruation Machine is a device that lets a man experience menstruation, speculative design about bodies, gender and technology.
orgs.description_zh: 日英混血艺术家，Menstruation Machine 是一台让男性体验月经的装置，以思辨设计探讨身体、性别与技术。

orgs.name: Yoichi Ochiai
orgs.description: Japanese media artist and researcher who proposes 'digital nature', a world where computation becomes a new nature beyond the human–machine divide.
orgs.description_zh: 日本媒体艺术家与研究者，提出“数字自然”：计算成为一种超越人机二分的新自然。

orgs.name: Naoko Tosa
orgs.description: Japanese media artist whose Neurobaby, an early emotion-recognising computer baby that reacts to the tone of your voice, pioneered artificial emotion in art.
orgs.description_zh: 日本媒体艺术家，早期作品《Neurobaby》是一个会根据你的语调作出反应的计算机婴儿，是情感识别艺术的先驱。

orgs.name: Wafaa Bilal
orgs.description: Iraqi-American artist who lived for a month in a gallery facing a paintball gun that internet users could aim and fire remotely, and who later implanted a camera in the back of his head.
orgs.description_zh: 伊拉克裔美国艺术家，曾在画廊中生活一个月，面对一把可由网友远程瞄准射击的彩弹枪；后来又在后脑植入一台摄像机。

orgs.name: Liam Young
orgs.description: Australian speculative architect and filmmaker whose Where the City Can't See is shot entirely through laser scanners, showing a city as a self-driving car perceives it.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚思辨建筑师与电影人，Where the City Can't See 全片以激光扫描仪拍摄，呈现自动驾驶汽车眼中的城市。

orgs.name: Theo Jansen
orgs.description: Dutch artist who since 1990 has evolved wind-walking 'beach animals' from PVC tubing, machines that store air, sense water and walk the shore on their own.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰艺术家，自 1990 年起用 PVC 管“进化”出靠风行走的“海滩生物”：这些机器能储存空气、感知海水，并独自在海岸上行走。

orgs.name: Garnet Hertz
orgs.description: Canadian artist and scholar of critical making whose robot is steered by a live Madagascar hissing cockroach riding on a trackball.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大艺术家与“批判制作”学者，他的机器人由一只站在轨迹球上的活马达加斯加发声蟑螂驾驶。

orgs.name: Rosa Menkman
orgs.description: Dutch artist and theorist of glitch and resolution whose work shows how compression standards and imaging machines decide what can be seen, including the forgotten women in test images.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰艺术家与故障、分辨率理论家，她的作品揭示压缩标准与成像机器如何决定什么可以被看见，包括测试图像中被遗忘的女性。

orgs.name: !Mediengruppe Bitnik
orgs.description: Swiss artist duo (Carmen Weisskopf and Domagoj Smoljo) whose Random Darknet Shopper, a bot with a weekly bitcoin budget, bought goods on the darknet and was then 'arrested' by Swiss police.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞士艺术二人组（Carmen Weisskopf 与 Domagoj Smoljo），其 Random Darknet Shopper 是每周拿到比特币预算、在暗网随机购物的机器人，后来被瑞士警方“逮捕”。
orgs.based_zh: 苏黎世，瑞士 / 伦敦，英国

orgs.name: Kazuhiko Hachiya
orgs.description: Japanese media artist whose Inter Dis-Communication Machine swaps the sight and sound of two people through head-mounted displays, so each lives inside the other's perception.
orgs.description_zh: 日本媒体艺术家，Inter Dis-Communication Machine 通过头戴显示器交换两个人的视觉与听觉，让彼此活在对方的知觉之中。

orgs.name: Philip Beesley
orgs.description: Canadian architect and artist whose 'living architecture' environments of fronds, sensors and chemistry breathe and ripple in response to visitors.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大建筑师与艺术家，他的“活体建筑”由叶片、传感器与化学装置构成，会随观众靠近而呼吸、起伏。

orgs.name: Random International
orgs.description: Art studio founded by Hannes Koch and Florian Ortkrass whose minimal robotic figures and swarms test how little movement we need to perceive something as alive.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Hannes Koch 与 Florian Ortkrass 创立的艺术工作室，其极简的机器人形体与群体装置检验：我们需要多少运动，才会把某物感知为活物。
orgs.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 柏林，德国

orgs.name: Suzanne Treister
orgs.description: British artist whose HEXEN 2.0 tarot cards and diagrams map the entangled histories of cybernetics, military research, the internet and counterculture.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，HEXEN 2.0 以塔罗牌与图谱描绘控制论、军事研究、互联网与反文化相互缠绕的历史。
known_for: The Holographic Universe Theory of Art History (2018)

orgs.name: Suzanne Kite
orgs.description: Oglála Lakȟóta artist and scholar whose performances and machine-learning works draw on Lakota ontology, where stones and machines can be relatives rather than tools.
orgs.description_zh: 奥格拉拉拉科塔族艺术家与学者，其表演与机器学习作品取自拉科塔本体论：石头与机器可以是亲属，而不仅是工具。
known_for: Making Kin with the Machines (2018, with Jason Edward Lewis et al.)

orgs.name: Simon Weckert
orgs.description: Berlin artist who pulled a handcart of 99 smartphones through empty streets and made Google Maps report a traffic jam, showing how platforms read the city through devices.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林艺术家，拉着装有 99 部智能手机的手推车走过空荡街道，让谷歌地图显示“交通拥堵”，揭示平台如何通过设备读取城市。

orgs.name: Jill Magid
orgs.description: American artist who in Evidence Locker asked Liverpool's CCTV operators to film her and wrote them love letters to retrieve the footage, making intimacy with the surveillance system.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，在 Evidence Locker 中请利物浦的监控操作员拍摄她，并以情书的形式申请调取录像，与监控系统建立一种亲密关系。

orgs.name: George E. Lewis
orgs.description: American composer, trombonist and AACM member whose Voyager is an improvising computer 'orchestra' that listens and answers, framed as a partner shaped by African American musical culture.
orgs.description_zh: 美国作曲家、长号手、AACM 成员，Voyager 是会聆听并回应的即兴计算机“乐团”，被视为受非裔美国音乐文化塑造的合作者。
known_for: Why Do We Want Our Computers to Improvise? (2018)

orgs.name: Laetitia Sonami
orgs.description: French-born composer who performed with the Lady's Glove, a sensor glove, and later Spring Spyre, an instrument trained with machine learning (Wekinator) to respond to her gestures.
orgs.description_zh: 法国出生的作曲家，以传感手套 Lady's Glove 演出，后来又创作了借 Wekinator 机器学习训练、会回应她手势的乐器 Spring Spyre。

orgs.name: Jennifer Walshe
orgs.description: Irish composer and vocalist who improvises with an AI trained on her own face and voice (ULTRACHUNK) and rewrites music history through machine-generated singing.
orgs.description_zh: 爱尔兰作曲家与歌者，与以她自己的面孔和声音训练的 AI 即兴合演（ULTRACHUNK），并借机器生成的歌声改写音乐史。
known_for: A Late Anthology of Early Music Vol. 1 (2020)

orgs.name: Merritt Moore
orgs.description: American ballet dancer and quantum physicist (DPhil, Oxford) who programs and dances duets with an industrial robot arm.
orgs.description_zh: 美国芭蕾舞者、量子物理学家（牛津大学博士），亲自为工业机械臂编程并与之跳双人舞。

orgs.name: Agnieszka Pilat
orgs.description: Polish-born painter who treats Boston Dynamics' Spot robots as studio companions and co-painters, staging machines as a new species learning to make marks.
orgs.description_zh: 波兰出生的画家，把波士顿动力的 Spot 机器狗当作画室伙伴与合作画家，把机器呈现为一个正在学习留下痕迹的新物种。

orgs.name: Desmond Paul Henry
orgs.description: British artist who built drawing machines from bombsight analogue computers in the early 1960s, among the first machine-made artworks exhibited in the UK.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，1960 年代初用轰炸瞄准器模拟计算机改装成绘图机器，其作品是英国最早展出的机器绘画之一。

orgs.name: Julien Prévieux
orgs.description: French artist whose What Shall We Do Next? has dancers perform gestures patented by tech companies, showing how bodies are measured and scripted by devices; Prix Marcel Duchamp 2014.
orgs.description_zh: 法国艺术家，What Shall We Do Next? 让舞者表演被科技公司申请专利的手势，揭示身体如何被设备测量与编写；2014 年马塞尔·杜尚奖得主。

orgs.name: Choy Ka Fai
orgs.description: Singaporean artist whose Prospectus for a Future Body stimulates dancers' muscles with electrical signals recorded from other dancers, asking whether movement memory can be transferred by machine.
orgs.description_zh: 新加坡艺术家，Prospectus for a Future Body 用记录自其他舞者的电信号刺激舞者肌肉，追问动作记忆能否经由机器传递。

orgs.name: Jaha Koo
orgs.description: South Korean theatre-maker whose Cuckoo shares the stage with three talking rice cookers, telling a story of loneliness and economic crisis in South Korea through household machines.
orgs.description_zh: 韩国剧场创作者，Cuckoo 与三台会说话的电饭煲同台，借家用机器讲述韩国经济危机中的孤独。

orgs.name: Elisa Giardina Papa
orgs.description: Italian artist whose Cleaning Emotional Data documents her own gig work labelling facial expressions for emotion-recognition AI, and whose Technologies of Care portrays online care workers.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利艺术家，Cleaning Emotional Data 记录她自己为情绪识别 AI 标注面部表情的零工劳动，Technologies of Care 描绘线上照护工作者。
orgs.based_zh: 纽约，美国 / 西西里，意大利

orgs.name: Andrew Norman Wilson
orgs.description: American artist who, while a contractor at Google, filmed the separately badged book-scanning workers, and then collected Google Books pages showing the scanners' fingers.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，在谷歌做合同工时拍摄了佩戴不同工牌的图书扫描工人，之后收集谷歌图书中留下扫描员手指的页面。

orgs.name: Clement Valla
orgs.description: French-American artist whose Postcards from Google Earth collects melted bridges and warped roads, not errors but the logic of a machine-made 3D world.
orgs.description_zh: 法裔美国艺术家，Postcards from Google Earth 收集“融化”的桥梁与扭曲的道路：它们不是错误，而是机器生成的三维世界的逻辑。

orgs.name: Esther Hovers
orgs.description: Dutch artist whose False Positives stages the eight 'anomalous behaviours' that intelligent surveillance systems are trained to flag, from standing still to walking against the flow.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰艺术家，False Positives 在街头重现智能监控系统被训练去标记的八种“异常行为”，从静止不动到逆流而行。

orgs.name: Manu Luksch
orgs.description: Austrian-born artist whose film Faceless is made entirely of her own CCTV footage obtained under data-protection law, in which the faces of others are erased.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利出生的艺术家，影片 Faceless 完全由她依据数据保护法调取的自己的监控录像组成，画面中其他人的脸均被抹去。

orgs.name: Hasan Elahi
orgs.description: Bangladeshi-American artist who, after being wrongly placed on a US terrorist watch list, began publishing tens of thousands of images of his whereabouts, over-feeding the surveillance machine.
orgs.description_zh: 孟加拉裔美国艺术家，在被误列入美国恐怖分子观察名单后，开始公开发布数以万计记录自己行踪的图片，用过量信息“喂饱”监控机器。

orgs.name: Jon Rafman
orgs.description: Canadian artist whose The Nine Eyes of Google Street View collects scenes captured by Street View's indifferent cameras, a portrait of the world seen by a machine that does not care.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大艺术家，The Nine Eyes of Google Street View 收集街景车漠然拍下的画面，描绘一个被毫不在意的机器所看见的世界。
known_for: The Nine Eyes of Google Street View (2009–)

orgs.name: Paul Sermon
orgs.description: British artist whose Telematic Dreaming projected a remote partner onto a bed via video link, an early and intimate experiment with telepresence.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，Telematic Dreaming 通过视频连线把远方的伙伴投影在床上，是远程临场的早期亲密实验。

orgs.name: Guy Ben-Ary
orgs.description: Argentine-born Australian bio-artist whose works wire living neurons to machines: MEART drew with a robot arm, and cellF is a synthesizer played by neurons grown from his own cells.
orgs.description_zh: 阿根廷出生的澳大利亚生物艺术家，把活体神经元接入机器：MEART 通过机械臂作画，cellF 是由他自身细胞培养的神经元演奏的合成器。

orgs.name: Harpreet Sareen
orgs.description: Indian-born designer-researcher of 'cyborg botany' whose Elowan is a plant that drives its robotic base towards light using its own electrical signals.
orgs.description_zh: 印度出生的设计师与研究者，提出“赛博植物学”；Elowan 是一株用自身电信号驱动机器人底座向光移动的植物。

orgs.name: Mariela Yeregui
orgs.description: Argentine artist whose small robots in Proxemia approach and retreat from each other and from visitors, making distance and touch the subject of machine behaviour.
orgs.description_zh: 阿根廷艺术家，Proxemia 中的小机器人彼此靠近又后退，也与观众保持距离，让距离与触碰成为机器行为的主题。
orgs.based_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯，阿根廷

orgs.name: robotlab
orgs.description: German group founded at ZKM in 2000 that takes industrial robots into art; in bios [bible] a robot arm writes out the entire Bible by pen, a monk's labour done by a machine.
orgs.description_zh: 2000 年于 ZKM 成立的德国团体，把工业机器人带入艺术；在 bios [bible] 中机械臂用笔抄写整部《圣经》，以机器完成修士的劳作。

orgs.name: Primavera De Filippi
orgs.description: Italian legal scholar and artist whose Plantoids are blockchain-based robotic 'plants' that own themselves, collect money and pay artists to make copies of them, a self-reproducing machine lifeform.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利法学学者与艺术家，Plantoid 是基于区块链、自我拥有的机器人“植物”：它们收集资金并雇佣艺术家复制自己，是一种自我繁殖的机器生命。
known_for: Blockchain and the Law (2018, with Aaron Wright)

orgs.name: Simone Giertz
orgs.description: Swedish inventor and YouTuber known as the 'queen of shitty robots', whose deliberately useless machines (a breakfast robot, a lipstick robot) turn failure into comedy.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞典发明家与 YouTube 创作者，被称为“烂机器人女王”，她刻意无用的机器（早餐机器人、涂口红机器人）把失败变成喜剧。

orgs.name: Tod Machover
orgs.description: American composer at MIT Media Lab whose robotic opera Death and the Powers imagines a man who uploads himself into 'the System', with a chorus of robots and a singing set.
orgs.description_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室美国作曲家，机器人歌剧《死亡与力量》设想一个人把自己上传进“系统”，由机器人合唱团和会“唱歌”的舞台共同演出。

orgs.name: Kraftwerk
orgs.description: German electronic band founded in 1970 whose robot doubles and 'man-machine' aesthetic made the fusion of musician and machine a pop image.
orgs.description_zh: 1970 年成立的德国电子乐队，其机器人替身与“人机”美学让音乐人与机器的融合成为流行文化形象。

orgs.name: Osamu Tezuka
orgs.description: Japanese manga artist (1928–1989) whose Astro Boy, a robot boy with a heart, shaped Japan's friendly image of robots and inspired generations of Japanese roboticists.
orgs.description_zh: 日本漫画家（1928–1989），其《铁臂阿童木》中有心的机器人男孩塑造了日本人对机器人的友善想象，并启发了几代日本机器人学家。
